\]

\[
f^{(3)}(s)+f^{(3)}(t)=6.
\]
If neither value were at least $3$, then both would be strictly less than $3$, contradicting their sum being $6$. Therefore one of $s,t$ is an $x\in(-1,1)$ with $f^{(3)}(x)\ge3$.
\end{proof}
